title: 第十七章 巨锤巨剑第十八章 战神殿
content_zh:
进入楼群后，武书就遇到了尴尬的问题，核心区域在哪？如何才能进入核心区域？
这时，一旁的李剑锋却是谨慎询问道，“武书，现在我们是要前往核心区域吗？”
武书不假思索的点头道，“李兄，我是有这个打算。”
九转幻绝阵的核心区域具体在什么地方，李剑锋是不知道的，竟然武书会选择向这个方向走，李剑锋相信肯定是有原因的。只是核心区域危险重重，以他们如今的实力进去，怕是有进无回。李剑锋便又是试探性道，“武书，现在的核心区域必然是危险重重，就算我们能够进入核心区域，我怕是最多也只能够做到保护自己。”
老实说，就算李剑锋拥有与魔族一战到底的热血，他也还是很清醒的。以他目前的实力，他还做不到越级挑战，更不可能与进入核心区域的那些魔族老家伙抗衡。
至于武书的选择，李剑锋是质疑的，却坚持相信的。李剑锋自身实力本就不凡，但像今天这样出风头的场面，真是让人爽啊？简直令人记忆深刻。在装这方面，似乎，李剑锋也受到了武书的感染。
被李剑锋这么一说，武书也是停下了脚步，先前装过头了，都忘记现在身处孤注峰半山腰了。话说，这九转幻绝阵的核心区域在哪里，该怎么走呢？
而在看到武书一副思考的样子，李剑锋道，“怎么了？武兄？是想到了什么吗？”
武书现在只觉得很尴尬，要是核心区域在其他地方，现在往回走，再与非鱼一干人等相遇，那场面会不会很酸爽。武书只感觉，真是鸡儿的冲动啊？
这个时候，神识中的碑灵小灵打破沉默道，“老大，你是想要前往大阵中心区域吗？小灵知道怎么前往中心区域。”
一听到小灵的话，武书立马就将小灵召唤了出来，在离开武书的神识，出现在武书的面前后，小灵立马是躬着身道，“老大，你的满意就是小灵的需求，小灵随时为老大你提供满意的服务。”
……
李剑锋、浮云虎小白、夜行兽看到小灵的表现，直接是凌乱了。李剑锋一度认为，眼前说话的这货，真的只是一个碑灵吗？这马屁拍的，就算是换做人族，也做不来它这样的。
与李剑锋等的反应截然不同，武书一把将碑灵抓到手里，很随意的道，“小灵，……”
而一听到武书称呼自己小灵，小灵是立马打断武书的说话道，“老大，这就是你的不对了。老大，你知道的，小灵现在已经是你的小弟了，你应该称呼小灵武灵才对。”
神识中的武左武右算是见识到小灵的舔狗本性了，不过，让武左武右特别不爽的是，小灵这货竟然想跟武书一个姓，一个小小的石灵，竟然想要与它们星灵一个地位的姓氏，这简直是公然在向权威发起挑战。
而令武左武右想不到的是，武书是不想再看到小灵继续啰嗦下去，便是道，“武灵，我们要进入核心区域，走吧！”
武左武右那豆腐心，瞬间有种要散掉的迹象。武左武右又是不得不佩服，小灵这货是真的能混啊？
得到武灵这个称号，小灵是非常开心的。
“老大，你抬头看看，看看有没有发现什么异样？”

被小灵这么一提醒，武书便是抬头看去，这么一瞧，武书还真是察觉到了端倪。现在武书等人的确是在孤注峰的半山腰，但是孤注峰的半山腰的广阔面积是不是太大了些。
武书恍然道，“武灵，难道说，我们现在是在九转幻绝阵的核心区域的边缘？而孤注峰被人拦腰斩断过，被阵法隔绝开的峰顶便是核心区域的中心位置。”
说起孤注峰的事情，小灵也是想起了过往的种种，小灵认真的点头道，“是的。”
而就在武书等人还在想该如何进入核心区域时，小灵却是仰头冲着天空道，“巨锤、巨剑，放我们进去。”
天空中突然照下一道光芒，紧接着武书、李剑锋等就是出现在一片灵气浓郁的山脉中。
小灵似乎对核心区域也是十分熟悉，在进入核心区域山脉后，小灵便是一副气势不凡的看着众人道，“这里就是绝阵的核心区域，放眼望去，你们便是能够发现这里与外界的不同。”
核心区域的确是和外界不同，放眼看去，中心的山峰高耸入云，在其周围是……
武书与李剑锋都是不敢相信自己的眼睛道，“那些是什么？”
小灵见怪不怪道，“几百米高的锤头啊？千米长的巨剑啊？怎么了？你们以前没见过这种灵器吗？”
武书都不敢相信自己的耳朵，小灵这说话口气，怎么听都是轻飘飘的。几百米高的锤头啊？千米长的巨剑啊？这是厚土大陆上的强者能够持有的兵器吗？
这些兵器的重量怕不是都要几十万斤起步。
就这个重量，落在厚土大陆上的很多城池，就能压死一片片炼体强者。
也是深刻感受到武书的惊讶，小灵语重心长道，“老大，我知道，在炼体方面，你现在实力还很弱。不过，现在竟然你进入了核心区域，小灵敢保证，不出一日，在炼体方面，老大你的实力就能够得到突飞猛进的提升。”
小灵说话本就口无遮拦，武书是不太相信它的鬼话的，小灵又是道，“谁让老大你姓武呢？而且还是来自厚土大陆最强大的炼器世家武家呢。”
不说武书被小灵说的一头雾水，一旁的李剑锋都感觉，这个碑灵小灵说话没条理，很跳脱。常人难以与之沟通。
小灵继续道，“在这核心区域，存在三种绝世炼体功法，天雷地火镇嶽天。老大，碰巧这三种功法的修炼方式小灵都有，等会见到小象了，我让小象放点精血进入修炼池，然后老大你进入修炼池泡泡，保证不出数个时辰，老大你就能进入蛮牛体境。”
而在听到，小灵说到天雷地火镇嶽天几个字时，武书能够清楚感受到，武左武右都是不淡定了。激动的心，颤抖的手。这样的武左武右，武书以前可是从来没有见到过。
真没想到，小灵这货身上真有这等宝贝。
又是想到了什么，小灵突然神情有些低落的道，“小灵这一激动，把一件很重要的事情搞忘记了。在厚土大陆上，觉醒天雷血脉、地火血脉是很容易的，可是要想觉醒镇嶽天体血脉，似乎是十分困难的，到现在小灵还没有见到过有人能够觉醒镇嶽天体血脉的。”
content_en:
After entering the building group, Wu Shu encountered an embarrassing problem. Where is the core area? How can I enter the core area?
At this time, Li Jianfeng on the side asked cautiously, "Wushu, are we going to the core area now?"
Wu Shu nodded without thinking, "Brother Li, I have this plan."
Li Jianfeng didn't know exactly where the core area of the Nine Revolutions Fantasy Array was. However, the Martial Arts Society chose to go in this direction. Li Jianfeng believed there must be a reason. It's just that the core area is full of dangers. With their current strength, they may not be able to return if they enter. Li Jianfeng said tentatively again, "Wushu, the current core area must be full of dangers. Even if we can enter the core area, I'm afraid we can only protect ourselves at most."
To be honest, even if Li Jianfeng has the passion to fight the demons to the end, he is still very sober. With his current strength, he is still unable to challenge the level, let alone compete with those old demons who enter the core area.
As for the choice of martial arts, Li Jianfeng doubted it, but insisted on believing it. Li Jianfeng's own strength is already extraordinary, but being in the limelight like today is so satisfying, isn't it? Simply memorable. In terms of pretending, it seems that Li Jianfeng was also infected by Wu Shu.
When Li Jianfeng said this, Wu Shu also stopped. He had been pretending too much before and had forgotten that he was now halfway up the Guzhu Peak. By the way, where is the core area of ​​the Nine Revolutions Fantasy Formation and how to get there?
When he saw Wu Shu thinking, Li Jianfeng said, "What's wrong? Brother Wu? Did you think of something?"
Wu Shu just felt very embarrassed now. If the core area was somewhere else, and if he walked back now and met Feiyu and the others, the scene would be sour. Wu Shu only felt that it was really a chicken's impulse?
At this time, Xiaoling, the tablet spirit in his consciousness, broke the silence and said, "Boss, do you want to go to the central area of the formation? Xiaoling knows how to get to the central area."
As soon as he heard Xiao Ling's words, Wu Shu immediately summoned Xiao Ling. After leaving Wu Shu's spiritual consciousness and appearing in front of Wu Shu, Xiao Ling immediately bowed and said, "Boss, your satisfaction is Xiao Ling's needs. Xiao Ling will provide you with satisfactory service at any time, boss."
…
Li Jianfeng, Fuyunhu Xiaobai, and Nightwalker were immediately confused when they saw Xiaoling's performance. Li Jianfeng once thought, was the guy talking in front of him really just a tablet spirit? Even if it were a human being, it would be impossible for this flattering person to do what he did.
Completely different from the reaction of Li Jianfeng and others, Wu Shu grabbed the stele spirit in his hand and said casually, "Little spirit,..."
As soon as he heard Wu Shu call him Xiao Ling, Xiao Ling immediately interrupted Wu Shu and said, "Boss, this is your fault. Boss, you know, Xiao Ling is your little brother now, you should call Xiao Ling Wu Ling."
In his spiritual consciousness, Wu Zuo and Wu You had seen Xiao Ling's dog-licking nature. However, what made Wu Zuo and Wu You particularly unhappy was that Xiao Ling actually wanted to have the same surname as Wu Shu. A small stone spirit wanted to have the same surname as their star spirits. This was a blatant challenge to authority.
What Wu Zuo and Wu You didn't expect was that Wu Shu didn't want to see Xiao Ling continue to talk, so he said, "Wu Ling, we have to enter the core area, let's go!"
Wu Zuo Wu You's tofu heart showed signs of falling apart instantly. Wu Zuo and Wu You couldn't help but admire him, could Xiao Ling really be able to get along?
Xiao Ling was very happy to receive the title of Wu Ling.
"Boss, look up and see if you find anything strange?"
After being reminded by Xiao Ling, Wu Shu looked up. With this look, Wu Shu really noticed the clues. Now Wu Shu and others are indeed halfway up the mountainside of Guzhu Peak, but the vast area halfway up Guzhu PeakIs the accumulation too big?
Wu Shu suddenly said, "Wu Ling, could it be said that we are now on the edge of the core area of the Nine Revolutions Fantasy Array? And Guzhu Peak has been cut off in the middle, and the peak isolated by the formation is the center of the core area."
Speaking of the incident at Gu Zhu Peak, Xiao Ling also thought of all the past events. Xiao Ling nodded seriously and said, "Yes."
While Wu Shu and others were still thinking about how to enter the core area, Xiaoling raised his head and said to the sky, "Giant hammer, giant sword, let us in."
A ray of light suddenly shone in the sky, and then Wu Shu, Li Jianfeng and others appeared in a mountain range rich in aura.
Xiao Ling seemed to be very familiar with the core area. After entering the core area mountains, Xiao Ling looked at everyone with an imposing manner and said, "This is the core area of Jue Zhen. If you look around, you can find the difference between this place and the outside world."
The core area is indeed different from the outside world. Looking at it, the central mountain peak towers into the clouds, surrounded by...
Wu Shu and Li Jianfeng both couldn't believe their eyes and asked, "What are those?"
Xiaoling was not surprised and said, "A hammer head hundreds of meters high? A giant sword a thousand meters long? What's wrong? Haven't you seen this kind of spiritual weapon before?"
Wu Shu couldn't believe his ears. Xiao Ling's tone sounded light and airy no matter how he sounded. A hammerhead hundreds of meters high? A thousand-meter-long giant sword? Is this a weapon that the strong men on the thick earth continent can hold?
The weight of these weapons may not all start at hundreds of thousands of kilograms.
With this weight, many cities falling on the thick earth continent can crush to death the body-refining experts one by one.
Also deeply feeling Wu Shu's surprise, Xiao Ling said earnestly, "Boss, I know that in terms of body refining, you are still very weak now. However, now that you have entered the core area, Xiao Ling can guarantee that in less than a day, boss, your strength will be improved by leaps and bounds in terms of body refining."
Xiao Ling always speaks freely, and Wu Shu doesn't quite believe his lies. Xiao Ling added, "Who told me that your surname is Wu, boss? And you are from the Wu family, the most powerful weapon refining family in the Houtu Continent."
Not to mention that Wu Shu was confused by what Xiao Ling said, Li Jianfeng on the side felt that Xiao Ling, the tablet spirit, spoke in an incoherent and out-of-focus manner. It is difficult for ordinary people to communicate with them.
Xiao Ling continued, "In this core area, there are three peerless body-training techniques. Heavenly thunder and earth fire suppress Yue Tian. Boss, it happens that Xiao Ling has the training methods of these three techniques. When I see the little elephant later, I will ask the little elephant to put some blood essence into the training pool, and then boss, you enter the bubble of the training pool. I guarantee that within a few hours, boss, you will be able to enter the wild bull body realm."
And when Xiaoling heard the words "Thunder, Earth, Fire, Zhen Yue Tian", Wu Shu could clearly feel that Wu Zuo and Wu You were not calm anymore. Excited heart, trembling hands. Wu Shu had never seen Wu Zuo Wu You like this before.
I really didn’t expect that Xiao Ling would have such a treasure.
Thinking of something again, Xiaoling suddenly said with a somewhat depressed expression, "Xiaoling was so excited that he forgot a very important thing. On the thick earth continent, it is very easy to awaken the Heavenly Thunder bloodline and the Earthfire bloodline, but it seems to be very difficult to awaken the Zhenyue Celestial Body bloodline. So far, Xiaoling has not seen anyone who can awaken the Zhenyue Celestial Body bloodline."
